title: parallax_engine/tools/render.py + tools/qa.py — MCP tool wrappers for renderer and QA
implementation_notes: render_scene wraps parallax_engine.render.render_scene; catches all exceptions and returns a JSON-serialisable status dict
diff_frames computes per-frame max/mean absolute pixel diff using numpy int16 subtraction; handles mismatched frame sizes via cv2.resize
ssim_score uses 11x11 Gaussian-windowed SSIM matching validate_portal_equivalence.py formula (cv2 + numpy, no skimage dependency)
All three tools return plain dicts with no non-serialisable values
Files created via workspace/gen_tools_modules.py Python generator (Write tool sandbox blocks parallax_engine/tools/ directory)
